summary: Code review complete — PASS with no changes required.

All six sealed records follow established Core model patterns exactly: Thumbnail mirrors Movie (required init), CropRect/CoverImageTransform/ThumbnailGenerationRequest/Result/Progress mirror ObfuscationProgress and RefreshProgress (positional constructors).
CoverImageTransform.Crop = null correctly satisfies the 'no crop' design intent.
ThumbnailGenerationResult bool-pair (Cancelled + Error) is consistent with existing flat-boolean approach.
CropRect normalised [0,1] range is documented but not runtime-enforced — intentional per Core model conventions.
No blocking issues, no fix-forward candidates. One documentation-forward recorded for api-surface.md.

comments.note: [documentation-forward] api-surface.md needs entries for all six new Core model types: Thumbnail, CropRect, CoverImageTransform, ThumbnailGenerationRequest, ThumbnailGenerationResult, ThumbnailGenerationProgress. Each should include the constructor signature (or required-init properties for Thumbnail) and a brief description of purpose.

CropRect documents the [0,1] normalised range constraint in XML but does not enforce it at runtime. This is intentional and consistent with the codebase's Core-as-value-container convention. No action needed, but future implementors of image processing services should validate before constructing CropRect.

ThumbnailGenerationResult uses bool Cancelled + bool Error as independent booleans — both can logically be true simultaneously. Pattern is consistent with existing flat-boolean approach in the codebase. Not blocking, but a discriminated union (sealed hierarchy) would be more type-safe if the model evolves.
ThumbnailGenerationProgress.FramesTotal uses 0 as sentinel for 'not yet known' — confirmed as consistent with RefreshProgress.Total which uses the same convention. No issues.
